label: Contamination
why_not_a_term_request: Not a place. BacDive records that a strain was isolated as a contaminant — of a product, a culture or a cleanroom — which is a circumstance of sampling rather than an environment ENVO models. ENVO:00002204 is kept as an xref (#99).

label: Invertebrates-Other
why_not_a_term_request: A residual bucket. 'Other' has no meaning of its own — it is defined by what the sibling categories already took — so there is no concept for an ontology to define.

label: Rodentia-Other
why_not_a_term_request: A residual BacDive #Host bucket for rodent hosts not assigned to the sibling #Muridae (Mouse/Rat). The host environment is real and parented to animal-associated environment, but a negative “everything else” partition is not a stable ontology class: its extension changes whenever the source vocabulary adds another sibling (#192).

label: Rock core/Sediment
why_not_a_term_request: Two materials conflated in one GOLD node. Requesting a term for 'rock core or sediment' would ask ENVO to mint the conflation; the fix belongs upstream in GOLD. Parented to sediment.
